summary: An index of the RFC series as of a date in December 1973, listing the documents published up to then so readers can find them.

plainLanguage.summary: RFC 598 is an index of the RFC series dated December 5, 1973. It helps readers find documents in the series without searching through them one by one.

subtitle: An index of RFC documents available in December 1973.

tldr.problem: Readers needed a way to locate RFC documents in the growing series.
tldr.mechanism: RFC 598 is an index of the RFC series dated December 5, 1973.
tldr.outcome: The document serves as a finding aid for the RFCs it lists.

today: RFC 598 is an archival index of the RFC series dated December 5, 1973.

sections.title: An Index to the RFC Series
sections.content: The title identifies this document as an RFC index dated December 5, 1973. It is a catalog intended to help readers locate RFC documents in the series.
sections.plainLanguage: This document is an index to the RFC series as of its stated date. Readers can use it to locate RFC documents.

sections.title: Using the Catalog
sections.content: The scanned pages contain the index entries. The document's purpose is to provide a reference list, rather than to define a protocol or describe a network service.
sections.plainLanguage: Use the entries as a reference for finding RFCs. The index itself does not specify how a protocol works.

sections.title: Scope of This Document
sections.content: RFC 598 records an index snapshot for December 5, 1973. Its subject is the RFC series and its entries, not a new technical mechanism.
sections.plainLanguage: The RFC captures a dated view of the document series. It is a finding aid, not a protocol specification.
